title: FerrumCraft ResourcePack
description: This resource pack add's custom models to your world. Models currently include custom currency: Copper, Silver, Gold, Platinum coins, as well as Ability Boost scrolls for wizard games. Strawhat included! More to come.
body:
This resource pack was created for use primarily by members of the FerrumCraftSMP to collectively add our custom models and so forth to be seen by the rest of the server members. If you would like to create your own minigame's using the models provided, that would be awesome!

Instructions on how to use will be added in changelogs.
  
More custom models are in the works as we prepare for our mini D&D quest style minigame for the entire server. We also have a bit more variety for our custom headgear! The other Ferrits are learning how to make custom models as well! The quality will only get better from here.

**Please keep in mind that all of these are cosmetic changes only! The only effects they have on gameplay are how you decide to use them! For example, on FerrumCraft the ability scrolls will be used to trigger redstone contraptions (item sorter locks) to act as casting spells.**
